claim_wording.text: Proposed: if the review point (s2) falls before the training demonstration (s3), the review would test a condition not yet shown. That could make the Right's conditional nature visible to the valley.

result.reasoning: The claim is framed as a proposal, with conditional wording (if, could), so it is a creative possibility rather than a record claim. Its premise that the Right is conditional on training appears in E7 and E3, both attributed agent_proposed. E1, which carries no proposal marking, states only that lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right from Book 20, not the condition. The order of the review point (s2) and the training demonstration (s3) is not stated in any cited item.
result.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
result.alternative_reading: The offered quote carries the conditional premise, but not the sequence the claim depends on. No cited item places a training demonstration in time, and E3 says only that the condition needs to be demonstrated. E7 also marks the review point as agent-proposed, with a source reversal it does not describe.
result.would_settle: The source's statement of the training condition, and the order of the review point and the first training demonstration.
result.creative_room: Open: the review could fall before any demonstration, so the valley meets the condition as a test; or after it; or the condition could stay unshown. Treat as proposals, not record: the training condition (E7, E3), the review point's placement, the lineages' stake, and the valley seeing the condition.
